headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.completionBudget_totalReservedBits_mono
headlines.statement:
∀ (d p P M N h : ℕ),
  p ≤ P →
    M ≤ N →
      Math115.CompletionRandomBudget.totalReservedBits d p M h ≤
        Math115.CompletionRandomBudget.totalReservedBits d P N h

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.completionBits_le_rawTight
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (z : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L) (h : ℕ),
  Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.bits r c U L hr hc z h ≤
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawTightCompletionBits (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L h

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawTightCompletionBits_le_old
headlines.statement:
∀ (rs cs : List ℕ) (U L h : ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawTightCompletionBits rs cs U L h ≤
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawUniformCompletionBits rs cs U L h
